source: runtime introspection on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell MoLab sandbox

environment.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

transformers_surface.hidden_states_layout: [B, S, hc_mult, hidden] between layers (matches source kit)
transformers_surface.main_hidden_hook: layers 40/41/42 forward outputs, mean(dim=2), concat in layer order

observed_interface.target_forward: Transformer.forward(input_ids, start_pos) -> (output_ids, logits, main_hidden); main_hidden = concat over dspark_target_layer_ids of h.mean(dim=2)
observed_interface.drafter_forward: Transformer.forward_spec(input_ids, main_hidden, start_pos) -> (output_ids[6], logits, confidence) when start_pos>0; None at start_pos==0 (prefill fills KV only)
observed_interface.drafter_prefill: forward_spec(start_pos=0): each DSparkAttention stores kv_norm(wkv(main_x)) into its windowed ring cache from the prompt main_hidden
observed_interface.draft_block: block_size=5: [committed_token, noise*4] embedded, 3 stages, markov head adds bigram logit bias per drafted position, sample(T=1.0)
observed_interface.drafter_kv: ring window_size=128 over TARGET projected hiddens (main_norm(main_proj(main_hidden))); draft tokens add their own KV at block positions
observed_interface.sparse_attn: per-query top-k gather, online softmax, attn_sink added to DENOMINATOR ONLY as exp(attn_sink - max) (virtual entry with no value contribution)
observed_interface.hyper_connections: hc_pre (sinkhorn: pre=sigmoid(mix*scale0+base)+eps, post=2*sigmoid(mix*scale1+base), comb=sinkhorn-normalized mix*scale2+base), hc_post (post*x + comb@residual)
observed_interface.moe_gate: sqrtsoftplus scores, bias shifts selection only, top-6, weights normalized *1.5 (MTP layers are learned-router, NOT hash)
observed_interface.expert: SwiGLU w1/w2/w3 with swiglu_limit=10 clamp (up clamped +-10, gate clamped max 10), fp32 compute in source
observed_interface.confidence_head: concat(hidden, markov_embed) -> proj -> scalar per position (fp32)

constraints_discovered.full_source_kit_route_blocked: kit requires tilelang kernels and all-on-GPU (~167GB) load; sandbox has 95GB VRAM single GPU
constraints_discovered.transformers_route: main model via device_map=auto works (proven by route capture); mtp.* must be loaded and executed manually
constraints_discovered.mtp_memory: 3 stages x 256 experts x 3 mats x 2048x4096 FP4-packed ~= 9.7GB; keep packed on GPU, dequant selected experts on the fly

stage2_plan.route: hybrid: transformers main model (target) + custom PyTorch DSpark stages (drafter) from observed interface
numerics_deviations: FP8 weights dequantized to bf16 (value-exact; GEMM accumulation path differs from source FP8 kernels)
FP4 experts dequantized to bf16 on the fly (value-exact per FP4 table)
KV cache stored bf16 (source quantizes to FP8)
stage2_plan.classification: DRAFTER_NUMERICS_DEVIATION_RECORDED; acceptance is model-property estimate pending source-numerics drafter + 3060 equivalence
interpretation_choices: chain verification: greedy argmax equality, first mismatch stops, bonus token emitted
drafter ring cache updated only at draft positions (kit demonstrates no full speculative loop in inference_generate.py)
